Title: Generally available: Azure Red Hat OpenShift new regions

Body.Content:
Azure Red Hat OpenShift is now available in three new regions: West Central US, Australia Central, and Sweden Central.

Azure Red Hat OpenShift provides highly available, fully managed OpenShift clusters on demand, and is monitored and operated jointly by Microsoft and Red Hat.
